name: Typeform
prompt: Build a conversational form builder with text, email, choice, rating, date, and file questions; conditional branching; themes; share links; response storage in SQLite; CSV export; response charts; and embeddable forms. Include keyboard-first answering, autosave, validation, and a clean mobile layout.
notes: The delightful one-question-at-a-time experience is straightforward. Complex integrations are not.
